_description: Citi Bike pricing assumptions for revenue estimation. All values are estimates based on publicly available Citi Bike pricing as of August 2026. These must be verified before any formal presentation.
_station_install_cost_note: $70,000/station x 250 stations = $17.5M, pegged to match SF's Feb 2023 MTC investment ($16M nominal) adjusted to 2026 dollars, so the 250-station ask is the same $17.5M figure everywhere in the app.
_city_revenue_share_note: Planning assumption from the team's own framing (~$5M city revenue share on ~$200M total revenue), not a verified figure from the actual NYC DOT/Lyft contract. Confirm before external use.
